quarterly_data.quarter: Infleqtion press release: Infleqtion UK to Develop Deployable Quantum Radio Frequency (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infleqtion was awarded £9 million (~$12M) by Innovate UK (UK Research and Innovation) under the Quantum Missions Primer programme to continue developing a deployable quantum radio frequency direction-finding system - its Quantum Spectrum-DF product, in the second phase of the Quantum Direction Finding (QuDiFi) project, using Rydberg-atom sensing instead of large antenna arrays; after a prototype was designed and tested in earlier work, phase two develops a robust deployable product validated in realistic operational environments for defence and civilian markets. Infleqtion is collaborating with Leonardo on the project.
